definitions.explanation: A report or publication issued once a month, typically summarizing activities, data, or progress over the preceding month. Common in business and government contexts.

examples.japanese: {月報|げっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧{月報|げっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめている→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I am compiling the monthly sales report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{月報|げっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: We must submit the monthly report to our supervisor by the end of each month.

notes:
A standard business and administrative term. Part of a series of periodic report terms organized by frequency.

RELATED REPORT TERMS:
- ⟦{日報|にっぽう}→日報：15933_nippou⟧: daily report
- ⟦{週報|しゅうほう}→週報：24168_shuuhou⟧: weekly report
- {月報|げっぽう}: monthly report
- {年報|ねんぽう}: annual report

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月報|げっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a monthly report
- {月報|げっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to prepare a monthly report
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧{月報|げっぽう}: monthly sales report
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{月報|げっぽう}: monthly operations report

USAGE:
Also used for the small booklet inserts ({月報|げっぽう}) included with individual volumes of a Japanese book series (⟦{全集|ぜんしゅう}→全集：11783_zenshuu⟧), containing author notes, essays, or commentary.
